title: Finite etale-local models agree with fixed-scalar pro-etale local models
statement: Let X be a scheme, B a finite commutative ring, R a sheaf of commutative rings on X_proet, phi an isomorphism from the constant sheaf of the universe lift of B to R, and V an etale chart [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Assume the constant module realization functor preserves zero morphisms. Let F be one R_0-module sheaf, where R_0 is the underlying ring sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let P(F) mean that for every etale W -> V there is an etale covering sieve of W on whose members Z the concrete pro-etale slice restriction of F is isomorphic to the restriction of ordinary scalar extension along phi of the lifted constant sheaf of some finite B-module N [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then P(F) is equivalent to the following condition on the already constructed fixed-scalar chart restriction H(F) [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction]: for every pro-etale object T over V.left, a pro-etale covering sieve of T has members U on whose slices H(F) is isomorphic to the constant ModuleCat(ULift B)-valued sheaf of a finite ULift B-module. This asserts a local-model comparison for one sheaf; it contains no functor existence, exactness or closure conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the forward split theorem, which transports etale finite local models through the fixed-scalar slice restriction and pulls covering sieves back along every pro-etale object.

Apply the reverse split theorem, which descends fixed-scalar finite pro-etale charts to etale charts using finite presentation over the finite coefficient ring and the coefficient-sized etale-cover theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ) (V : X.Etale)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ)).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    P F ↔ ProFiniteModels.fixedModels (ProEt.topology V.left) (ULift.{t + 1} B)
      ((finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).obj F)
